title: 83. How do I give other users access to the results of my survey?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I give other users access to the results of my survey.
short_answer: Open your survey, go to the 'Privileges' page and give results access to other users. Read more about this under ' How do I give other users access to my survey? '.
